notes:
Qualify for Private VPC deployment - notes from calls and threads:
- Customer: Silverpine MLOps (fintech analytics platform for trading signals). Sensitive PII + market data; dual residency requirement (NA for US clients, EU for EU clients).
- Primary workload: low-latency chat assistant for traders (90th pct latency target <120ms), embeddings indexing for real-time similarity, occasional reranking on recall pipelines. Throughput: 200 rps peak, burst to 800 for market open - cost sensitivity moderate but SLA/latency > cost.
- Security asks: must support SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS/HSM (bring your own), full audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, retention controls, and proof of SOC2/ISO roadmap.
- Network/architecture: prefer VPC peering (private) in us-east-1 and eu-west-1; require clear inbound/outbound rules (no inbound from internet to private nodes, outbound to specific S3 endpoints and metrics endpoints only). Discussed NAT gateway patterns vs. egress proxies.
- Quote from CTO: "We can't have model telemetry or request logs leaving the region without a contract and explicit retention rules."
- SE notes (Maya): propose Private control plane with customer VPC peering + dedicated inference pool in region, KMS integration via customer KMS proxy, and audit log forwarding to their CloudWatch/Datadog. Need to validate HSM key wrapping flows for tokenization.
- Actionables: send VPC peering checklist, sample network ACLs, and KMS integration RFC. Prepare SOC2 artefacts and a short runbook for legal's data residency questions.
- Risks: legal may require on-prem enclave for some EU customers (escalation path to Private on-prem package), HSM procurement could add 6-8 weeks to timeline.
- Buyer signals: agreement on POC scope, willing to sign NDA, procurement interested in 12- to 24-month committed capacity if privacy controls satisfied.
- Links to artifacts: pricing draft (drive), architecture v1 (drawio), meeting transcript (ff-2024-11-18-01).
- CRM shorthand: "POC scope approved by eng lead, security wants SOC2 & KMS flow, legal > residency question. Next = architecture + security kickoff."
notes_short: POC for Private VPC. VPC peering + KMS + audit logs required. Latency SLOs tight (90th <120ms). Legal holds on residency. Pricing in review.
initial_qualification_summary: Customer qualifies for Private VPC: enterprise with regulated data, firm requirements for KMS and audit logging, multi-region residency need (NA + EU), and clear latency/throughput targets. Infrastructure team available but limited bandwidth; timeline dependent on HSM procurement and legal sign-off.
technical_fit_summary: Recommended architecture: customer VPC peering -> private subnets hosting inference nodes in us-east-1 and eu-west-1; egress restricted via VPC endpoints to storage and metrics; control plane exposed via private interface or customer-managed relay; KMS integration via customer-owned keys with envelope encryption; audit logs pushed to customer's SIEM. Must validate HSM wrapping and latency impact of cross-region key calls.
